howTo.title: How it works
howTo.item1: The checkbox appears in the checkout on the confirmation page, below the terms agreement, as soon as Show newsletter checkbox is active.
howTo.item2: It only appears when the email address is not subscribed to the newsletter yet — for addresses that already are, the spot stays empty.
howTo.item3: Guest orders are included; a customer account is not required to subscribe.
howTo.item4: The subscription happens when the order is submitted, not when the box is ticked.
howTo.item5: Whether a confirmation email is required is decided by the shop's double opt-in setting — this plugin does not change it.

info.description: Adds a newsletter opt-in checkbox to the checkout confirmation page and automatically subscribes consenting customers to the newsletter via double opt-in after purchase.
